mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) has a negative relationship with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, such that higher rates predict negative returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 295.0, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to inflation-driven market volatility.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 295.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive (win rate < 60%).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) is above 100.0, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overheating economic conditions.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and INDPRO > 100.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive (win rate < 60%).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 2.5% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns during monetary tightening cycles are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in more than 50% of cycles.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600.0 thousand units, the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to strong economic demand.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1600.0, the 5-day forward returns are negative (win rate < 60%).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to economic contraction.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive (win rate < 60%).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600.0, the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to a strong labor market and housing demand.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1600.0, the 20-day forward returns are negative (win rate < 60%).

mechanism_narrative: During economic contractions (defined by INDPRO below 100.0), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns during economic contractions (INDPRO < 100.0) are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in more than 50% of contractions.
